Portfolio of Portfolios
Every team's direction, one map
X = Win-Now (your projected starter PPG rank within that league) · Y = Future (dynasty value + age-adjusted asset stack, ranked within that league). Player value uses the average of your rankings and Expert Average (falls back to whichever exists when only one has the player). Both axes normalized 0–100 per league, so a dot in the upper-right means "you're at the top of this league on both dimensions" — not that this roster is your absolute strongest. Click a dot to jump to that league's Portfolio.

Roster value breakdown
Paste a Sleeper draft ID above and hit Sync to see rosters.
Import Rankings from CSV
Pick which source you're importing, choose the format, then select your CSV. The import is saved as a separate ranking source you can switch to in the Startup ADP tab — your own rankings are never touched.
Season Market Futures
Paste season-long over/unders straight from a sportsbook — passing yards, rushing yards, receptions, TDs. These are the market's own player projections, and they're usually sharper than fantasy sites. Grab them before Week 1 — books pull season futures once games start.
Generate Market Rankings from Your Drafts
Builds a consensus ranking from a curated corpus of 2026 startup drafts. Scans your own drafts + every league mate's drafts, plus any drafts you paste in. Filter the corpus by format / team size / scoring before aggregating, so you only build rankings from comparable leagues.

Import KeepTradeCut Rankings
Pulls the live KTC dynasty rankings and saves two named sources: KTC 1QB (no superflex, no TE premium) and KTC SF TEP (superflex with TE premium). Skip picks — KTC names them by slot (e.g. "2026 Early 1st") which don't map 1:1 to your generic pk1–pk8 buckets.
Curve steepness 1.7
Balanced — moderate dropoff after top 10
Higher = harder to stack low-end assets to match elite players.
Value floor
Min player value 50
The lowest-ranked player's value. Prevents anyone from being worth zero. Rank 1 is always 9999.
Fairness threshold
Acceptable gap 1,500
Trades whose value gap is under this number are marked fair. Set to whatever value equals your "throw-in / worthless" cutoff — anything you'd give up for free to close a deal.
Top asset protection
Elite rank cutoff Top 12
Stack penalty 10%
When an elite player is involved and the other side has 2+ extra assets, reduce that side's value by this %.
Draft pick values
Pick values are now determined by their position in your Rankings list — drag picks up or down in the Rankings tab to set their value relative to players.
The trade calculator and teams chart both pull pick values from their rank position.
Market data
Used by the Buy / Sell tab to find gaps between your rankings and market consensus.
